Use a simple clear pose rather than hiding anatomy behind effects. Keep open spaces between limbs and both wings readable. Whole body, every foot, wing and tail tip inside central 80% with breathing room. Readable at 170px. One square 1:1 illustration. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, frame, border or UI. Do not include text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature or logo. Avoid extra limbs, extra eyes or pupils, fused hands or paws, disconnected joints, deformed anatomy, blurry or cropped subjects. Creature paws stay species-appropriate; Tamer hands are clearly drawn cartoon hands. Species QC: two distinct front claws and eight small walking legs, one shell/body, one coherent pair of eyes; no extra claws.
review: Reviewed final anatomy repair: eight walking legs (four per side), two claw arms and two eyes on stalks; no extra face eyes. Approved.
